about: The one list of capabilities the public site may mention (SITE-PAGES-8OCT section 4). A capability sentence in page data ends with {{F-ID}}. scripts/features-gate.mjs fails on an unknown id, on a PENDING PROOF id on a page that is not marked claimUntilProven, and on an id no page uses.

features.statement: The Free plan: 15 documents and 5 new templates a month, 10 AI drafts a month, 15 different signers a month, one team member (the owner), 25 MB uploads and a list send of up to 15. Everything you need to send, sign and seal is included; nothing is billed for going over, sending simply stops at the limit.

features.statement: Pro: one flat monthly price for the workspace; unlimited documents, templates, signers and team members; 100 AI drafts each billing month included, then $0.30 each; 0% fee on payments; 100 MB uploads; your own plays and playbooks.
Docustay's fee on payments taken in a document: 2% on Free and Pay as you go, 0% on Pro and Lifetime, on top of Stripe's fees.
Send a document to one or more people for signature, from a template or an uploaded file.
Signing on a phone or a computer, with no account, by email link or with an access code.
The finished PDF is sealed with a digital signature over the whole file.
A certificate of completion as the last page: who signed, when, and a hash of the file.
A verify page that checks a signed PDF in the browser, with no account.
Signing order: one at a time, or everyone at once.
Automatic reminders until everyone has signed, on every plan.

features.statement: 54 built-in templates, all ordinary templates, each with its roles and fields placed.
Upload a PDF file. Docustay only accepts PDF files.
Saved signers (a People list).
People in a workspace, with owner, admin and member roles, on every paid plan.
A payment field in a document, charged through the customer's own Stripe account.
Describe a document; Scribe writes it, places the fields and sets payment terms; you review it before it is sent. Payment terms need Stripe connected.

features.statement: Built-in Plays are free; your own Plays and Playbooks are on Pro and Lifetime.
The Plays and Playbooks API.
Hosted: email comes from Docustay with your sender name and reply-to address. Self-hosted installs can also send from their own domain, mailbox or SMTP server.
A REST API with idempotency keys, key scopes, key expiry, an address allowlist and an API log.
Seven signed document events, replay from the log and secret rotation.
Test keys and test mode: nothing is emailed except to the sender, with a TEST watermark.
An embedded signer, builder and Scribe widget.
SDKs for JavaScript, TypeScript and Python; clients for Go, PHP and C# generated from the API description.

features.statement: A command line: login, send --test, listen, verify, logs.
An MCP server and a hosted connector so an assistant can work on drafts.
Draft-only keys with daily limits and a human approval before anything is sent.
Run Docustay on your own server: compose and Helm files, Render, Fly and Coolify configs; the Community edition is free.
Self-host Pro is $390 a year per install, for your own business.
AGPL-3.0; a commercial licence from about $3,000 a year to ship it in your own product, white-label, resell or keep a private fork.
Passkey sign-in (behind a flag).

features.statement: Single sign-on through OpenID Connect for a self-hosted install.
An audit log of every step on a document, with a CSV export of the log.
What a Docustay signature is: a simple electronic signature with a strong record and a digital seal. No qualified signatures, no identity checks, no legal advice.
Free is for one team member (the owner). Pay as you go charges $5 per team member a month; Pro and Lifetime have unlimited team members. Signers are free on every plan.
API keys carry the scopes you tick: twelve of them, from the broad documents:read and documents:write down to one-job scopes such as templates:read.

AI drafts included in each plan: 10 a calendar month on Free, 10 on Pay as you go, 100 on Pro and 50 on Lifetime each billing month. A paid plan can go past it at $0.30 a draft; Free stops. A failed or empty draft is never charged.
A workspace can bring its own AI provider key; platform credits are then not used.
A free browser-only tool that puts a picture of a signature on a PDF; the file never leaves the visitor's browser.

features.statement: Two-step sign-in (an authenticator app or a passkey) is offered to everyone; an owner can require it for the whole team; sessions can be listed and ended, and a workspace can sign people out after a period without activity.
Every view, download and export by the team is written to an access log in every workspace; owners and admins can list it and download it as CSV.

features.statement: Every Pro control wears one lock: a lock icon and a Pro tag; pressing it shakes the lock and shows a tip with Explore Pro, which opens what Pro adds and the pricing page.

Paying is the last step of signing: the signer signs, then pays on the same page through embedded Stripe Checkout. Their signature is kept for 7 days while they pay; the document seals when the payment lands, and the receipt comes with the signed copy.

The Payments page lists every payment taken while signing (who paid, for which document, its status) with this month's money in, Stripe's own fees and refunds. A refund, in full or in part, goes through Stripe with a reason the payer sees on their receipt and that goes in the audit trail; disputes open in Stripe. The same list and refunds are in the API.

features.statement: Pay as you go: $5 per team member a month, 25 new templates a month, 15 documents each billing month included then $0.50 each, 10 AI drafts each billing month included then $0.30 each, 2% fee on payments. Billed monthly in arrears, and early if about $50 builds up.
Lifetime: $299 once for any workspace. Pro for as long as Docustay runs the hosted service; 50 AI drafts each month from your purchase date included, then $0.30 each.
A monthly spending budget (default $50) with alerts at 50%, 80% and 100%. At 100% sending and AI drafting pause with a clear message; raising the budget resumes them. Nothing is deleted.

features.statement: GET /api/v1/usage returns the running bill: documents, AI drafts, what is billable this month, the budget and whether sending is paused.
Your logo, brand colour, welcome note, sender name and reply-to address, on every hosted plan. The Docustay footer stays on hosted signed copies; a self-hosted install can remove it.
